violations.text: An allergen statement was not present of the menu or menu boards. An allergen statement shall be present on the menu, menu board, or at the point of sale alerting the consumer to notify the establishment if anyone in their party has a food allergy. An allergen statement was added to the menu board during the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/17/2026

A knife was observed stored between prep units between uses. Utensils between uses shall be maintained in one of the following manners: on a dry clean surface, in water that is maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or more, or in water with sufficient flow to flush particulates to the drain. The knife was cleaned and sanitized during the time of inspection and moved to a dry clean surface. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/17/2026
Refrigerator door gaskets were observed in poor repair on prep unit #3. Refrigerator door gaskets shall be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 09/17/2026
The 2-door low boy located in the cookline area was observed with the left door falling off when the door is opened and is not in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 09/17/2026

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. Establishment is to register employee with RIDOH Center for Food Protection. New Violation. Correct By: 04/04/2025

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. Establishment is to register employee with RIDOH Center for Food Protection. New Violation. Correct By: 03/26/2025

Marinara sauce and French onion soup, which was previously cooked and cooled, was removed from refrigeration and placed directly into the steam table for hot holding. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food that is cooked, cooled, and reheated for hot holding must be reheated to 165 degrees Fahrenheit or above for 15 seconds. Food items were loaded into unit less than 2 hours prior to inspection and were reheated during time of inspection. Proper reheating procedures reviewed with PIC. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 03/26/2025

Various deli salads were observed held at temperatures ranging from 46-48 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Food items were voluntarily disposed of during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 03/26/2025

The hand sink by the 3-bay sink in the kitchen was observed to be draining slowly during time of inspection. Plumbing fixtures shall be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 04/09/2025
